ssj.name: ssj
ssj.description: Solve and analyze heterogeneous-agent general-equilibrium models with the sequence-space Jacobian method (the official `sequence-jacobian` package). Use it to answer questions a representative-agent model cannot: how the wealth/MPC distribution shapes prices and dynamics, who-gains-who-loses, distributional general equilibrium, and impulse responses mediated by the cross-section. Finance uses include heterogeneous-agent asset pricing (the link from wealth distribution to risk premia), household portfolio choice under aggregate risk, and intermediary/term-structure models; macro uses include HANK and inequality-and-business-cycle models. You write the economics (the het block + market clearing in a .py module); the driver `code/utils/ssj/ssj_solve.py` runs steady state, GE Jacobians, determinacy, IRFs, and plots in sequence. Deterministic. Installed by setup.sh (pulls in numba).
